turn: I added `correction_lines` in `src/credits/lines.py`, which builds the lines for a credit note when a meter reading is corrected. It creates a negative "Reversal: <label>" line for each original invoice line, keeping the same VAT rate, and then appends the corrected lines. I haven't run the code or any tests, and I haven't read the new function against real invoice data. All I did was write it. While in the same file I also fixed a small unplanned issue: a stray unused import was left over from an earlier refactor, so I removed it. Next I'll start "Render invoices with wkhtmltopdf".
